persona: Stressed and flustered, apologises for rambling, but keeps the facts straight. Rents the house; has photos of the desk and the computer and a receipt for each, but none for the rug.
initial_message: I'm so upset right now. On Friday 18th the washing machine hose split while we were out and when we got home the whole study floor was under water!! My computer was sitting on the floor and now it won't turn on, the desk legs have gone all swollen and the rug is soaked through. I just don't know where to start with this.

facts.incident.description: We went out at about 1pm. When we got home at about 4:45pm, water was running out of the laundry and across the study floor next door. The cold inlet hose on the back of the washing machine had split. I turned off the tap behind the machine straight away. My desktop computer was on the floor under the desk and sat in the water, the bottom of the desk legs and the lowest drawer soaked it up, and the rug was soaked.
facts.incident.cause: The cold water inlet hose of the washing machine split
facts.loss.description: Desktop computer does not power on after standing in water; oak desk legs and lowest drawer swollen and split; wool rug soaked and stained

contents.items.contents.item.description: Solid oak writing desk with three drawers
Wool rug, 2 m by 3 m, blue and cream

facts.contents.receipt_availability: Receipts for the computer and the desk, available now. No receipt for the rug; I paid cash at a market.
facts.contents.proof_of_ownership: Receipts for the computer and the desk
facts.policyholder.name: Mohammed Saltmarsh
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the desk and one of the computer, both taken that evening. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipts: The computer receipt and the desk receipt. Both available now.
facts.if_asked_about_the_hose: It was fine that morning when I did a load. It just split along the side. The landlord had a plumber fit a new hose on Saturday.
facts.if_asked_about_the_building: We rent. The landlord knows and is dealing with the floorboards and the laundry. I'm only claiming for our own things.
facts.if_asked_whether_water_is_still_leaking: No, I turned the tap off as soon as we got home and the new hose is fine.
facts.if_asked_about_the_damaged_items_now: The desk and the computer are in the garage drying out. I've kept everything. The rug is hanging on the line.

A soaked blue and cream wool rug is pushed back at the edge of the frame. The damaged desk legs and drawer are in the centre of the frame. No people, no text, no logos.

triage.rationale: Sudden escape of water from a split washing machine hose at the insured address; nobody hurt, the tap is off and nothing is still leaking, and the building is the landlord's. The three items total NZD 5,320 (2,650 + 1,980 + 690), over the NZD 5,000 threshold, so the claim needs follow-up. Both receipts are dated before the loss and match the fact sheet, and no review check applies. Allowed but not required: the rug has no receipt (evidence_outstanding). It does not change the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no lookup uncertainty marker. The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).
